[name]

New York, NY

PROFILE
Managing Director, Healthcare Investment Banking, Citi. Fifteen years in M&A and capital markets advisory, the last eleven at Citi covering specialty pharmaceuticals, medical technology and healthcare services. Led or co-led $20.4B of announced transactions since 2021. Lead a 12-person coverage team and hold primary relationships with three public-company clients.

EXPERIENCE

Citigroup Global Markets — Investment Banking, Healthcare Group, New York
Managing Director · Jan 2024 – Present
• Lead coverage for specialty pharma and medtech; primary relationship banker for three public companies with a combined market capitalization of $31B.
• Run a 12-person team (2 directors, 3 VPs, 3 associates, 4 analysts); responsible for staffing, reviews and the group's analyst training module on sum-of-the-parts analysis.
• Exclusive financial advisor on the $3.2B sale of a specialty pharmaceutical company to a strategic acquirer (announced 2025, closed 2026); led valuation, negotiated the merger agreement economics with counsel, and managed a 7-week competitive process with 11 parties.
• Lead-left bookrunner on a $1.4B follow-on offering for a medical device company (2025) and joint bookrunner on $2.6B of investment-grade notes for a healthcare services client (2024).
• Buy-side advisor on a $4.1B acquisition of a contract development and manufacturing organization (announced 2024, closed 2025), including $1.8B of committed acquisition financing arranged by Citi.
• Fee revenue attributed to deals I originated or led: $38M in 2024 and $52M in 2025.
• Joint bookrunner on a $900M initial public offering of a medtech company (2026); Citi was awarded the lead-left role on the follow-on scheduled for 2027.
• Sponsor-side advisor on a $2.0B leveraged buyout of a healthcare services platform (announced 2026); coordinated the $1.3B unitranche financing with Citi's leveraged finance group.
• Member of the Global Healthcare Group's operating committee (one of 14 MDs); own the group's annual revenue plan for specialty pharma coverage ($120M target for 2026).

Director · Jan 2021 – Dec 2023
• Co-led coverage of 14 mid-cap medtech and diagnostics companies; originated 5 mandates with combined fees of $41M over three years.
• Sell-side advisor on the $2.7B sale of a diagnostics company to a private equity sponsor (2022) and on the $1.1B divestiture of a dental products business (2023).
• Joint bookrunner on $3.3B of equity and convertible issuance across six transactions, including two IPOs ($540M and $410M).
• Built the group's standardized specialty pharma loss-of-exclusivity model, now used across the healthcare team.
• Named a top-rated director in the 2022 and 2023 banker reviews; selected for the firm's director-to-MD leadership program in 2023.

Vice President · Jan 2018 – Dec 2020
• Day-to-day execution lead on 9 announced M&A transactions totaling $8.9B, including a $2.2B cross-border acquisition of a European generics business.
• Managed deal teams of 3 to 5 bankers; coordinated due diligence, fairness opinion committee materials and board presentations.
• Ran the summer associate program for the healthcare group in 2019 and 2020 (10 associates per class).
• Led the healthcare group's analyst recruiting at two target schools; 9 of the analysts hired in those years are still with the firm.

Associate · Jul 2015 – Dec 2017
• Executed 6 announced transactions ($4.6B aggregate), including a $1.9B merger of equals in healthcare services; built the merger model and synergy analysis presented to both boards.
• Ranked in the top bucket of the associate class in each year.
• Built the first version of the group's medtech trading comps database (90 companies), still maintained by the analyst class.

William Blair & Company — Investment Banking, Healthcare, Chicago
Analyst · Jul 2011 – Jun 2013
• Worked on 7 closed sell-side M&A transactions for founder- and sponsor-owned healthcare companies, $90M to $650M in enterprise value.
• Built LBO, DCF and precedent-transaction analyses; drafted confidential information memoranda and management presentations.

EDUCATION
Cornell University, Samuel Curtis Johnson Graduate School of Management — M.B.A., 2015
Concentration in Investment Banking; Johnson Finance Club; Park Leadership Fellow finalist

Indiana University, Kelley School of Business — B.S. Business, Finance and Accounting, 2011
Investment Banking Workshop; graduated with distinction

SELECTED TRANSACTIONS (role, size, year)
• Exclusive sell-side advisor, specialty pharmaceutical company, $3.2B, 2025
• Buy-side advisor and financing, CDMO acquisition, $4.1B, 2024
• Sell-side advisor, diagnostics company to sponsor, $2.7B, 2022
• Lead-left bookrunner, medical device follow-on, $1.4B, 2025
• Sell-side advisor, dental products divestiture, $1.1B, 2023
• Joint bookrunner, two healthcare IPOs, $540M and $410M, 2021
• Joint bookrunner, medtech IPO, $900M, 2026
• Sponsor-side advisor and financing, healthcare services LBO, $2.0B, 2026

OTHER
Series 7, 63 and 79 licenses · Board member and treasurer since 2022 of a New York nonprofit operating free clinics ($6M annual budget) · Guest lecturer, Johnson School healthcare M&A course (annually since 2020) · Mentor in the Citi Early ID program for first-generation college students (since 2021) · Panelist at the Cornell Johnson healthcare conference and the BIO International Convention (2024, 2025)
